headline: Pentagon sending USS Theodore Roosevelt carrier strike group + 13th MEU / USS Makin Island amphibious ready group
dek: The Pentagon is deploying the USS Theodore Roosevelt carrier strike group, the USS Makin Island amphibious ready group and the 13th Marine Expeditionary Unit (~10,000 sailors/Marines) to the Middle East, expected to arrive by end of November. Roosevelt left San Diego Sep 27, was at Yokosuka Oct 16…
sources: Two US officials via Fox News; JPost (James Genn); US Naval Institute News
fault_line: Is the third carrier strike group a deterrent building bargaining leverage for the deal — or the invasion force for post-midterm strikes on Iran?
